title: Events
description: One-off occasions with their own page — concerts, tours, summits, exhibitions.
newDescription: Pick a look, add the details, price the tickets. Publish when you're ready.

step.categoryTitle: What kind of event is it?
step.categoryHelp: This picks the template, the palette and the typefaces. You can change all of them next.
step.typeHelp: Used on the page as the label above the title, and to group the event in reports.
step.ticketsHelp: Most events sell better with two or three tiers than with one.
step.publishHelp: This is exactly what people will see. Publish now, or keep it as a draft.
step.designHelp: Look and content together. Every change lands in the preview as you make it.

categoryBlurb.entertainment: Concerts, festivals, comedy, screenings. Poster energy, lineup up front.
categoryBlurb.sports: Matches, tournaments, classes. High contrast, schedule and sign-up first.
categoryBlurb.business: Conferences, seminars, launches. Clean and structured, agenda and speakers.
categoryBlurb.arts: Exhibitions, fashion, cultural nights. Editorial, generous whitespace.
categoryBlurb.travel: Tours, trips, cruises. Immersive photography and a day-by-day itinerary.
categoryBlurb.nightlife: Clubs, raves, DJ nights. Dark, neon, lineup and door policy.

customise.sectionsHelp: Reorder with the arrows. Hero and Tickets always show.
